purpose: Teach: ロク/オンリー/゛/トロツキー/健太郎/二郎/ロビン/みずほ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の打ち合わせをロク、つまり六時に始めろ
lines.en: Ren — I want you to start the paper meeting at six.
lines.style: Clear, measured directive. Slight warmth beneath the instruction. Direct eye contact. No pause between name and task — efficient but not cold.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室のオンリーワン手法を社内発表します
lines.en: Yes. I'll present the lab's unique methodology.
lines.style: Quiet, focused. Lean slightly forward with intent. Respectful but genuine — not obsequious. Light emphasis on 'unique' to show he understands what matters.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、原稿の濁点、つまり゛の校正を丁寧におこなえ
lines.en: Ren — make sure you proofread the manuscript carefully. Pay attention to the details.
lines.style: Steady, fatherly tone without condescension. Slight pause after the name. The instruction is a gentle reinforcement, not a rebuke. Communicates trust underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。トロツキー革命の論文を読みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll review the papers carefully to prepare.
lines.style: Determined exhale. Hands planted. He's absorbing the instruction seriously, already thinking ahead. Not rushed, but purposeful.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、後輩の健太郎くんを面倒見てあげろ
lines.en: Ren — look after Kentaro, our junior. Take him under your wing.
lines.style: Slight soften in tone. This is less about task, more about trust. Brief pause after the name to signal a shift to something more personal. Warm directness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の同期、二郎くんと共同研究します
lines.en: Yes. I'll collaborate with Jiro on joint research.
lines.style: Quick, earnest agreement. Head nod slight but definite. He's already mapping out how this fits into his workload. Respectful cadence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、海外研究員ロビン氏との論文を共著しろ
lines.en: Ren — co-author the paper with Robin from the overseas research program.
lines.style: Deliberate, clear emphasis. This is significant work being entrusted. Slight lean forward. The pause after the name signals the importance of what follows.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の入金は、みずほ銀行口座で確認します
lines.en: Yes. I'll confirm the research funds in my Mizuho account.
lines.style: Focused, almost to himself. Practical note-taking energy. Calm agreement. Slightly trailing off at the end as he's already mentally moved to the next task.
